10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:b9682970-941a-48.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an accomplished Principal Software Engineer passionate about shaping the future of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Principal Software Engineer – AI Trainer and leverage your technical expertise to enhance advanced AI models, all while enjoying the freedom of remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects top independent professionals with leading AI labs to drive artificial intelligence advancement. We are looking for skilled software engineers based in the EU or UK to contribute to the training of AI systems in software architecture, engineering best practices, and technical problem-solving. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to software engineering, system architecture, and coding standards - Assess the accuracy and practicality of AI-driven recommendations on software design, testing, and implementation - Develop real-world case studies and technical scenarios from your professional experience - Create scenario variations covering software development lifecycle, technical challenges, and industry best practices - Identify and articulate gaps or risks in AI recommendations, providing clear, structured feedback - Influence how AI systems interpret and apply engineering principles and coding standards About You: - Experienced Principal Software Engineer with a strong background in software architecture, development, and technical leadership - Based in the EU or UK - Deep understanding of multiple programming languages, architectural patterns, and software development best practices - Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of delivering actionable, structured feedback - Available 8–20 hours per week and comfortable with remote, asynchronous collaboration Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance assignments – 100% remote - Help shape how AI systems understand and apply software engineering principles - Access ongoing professional development through the 10x Team AI Academy - Supportive community of independent experts with clear briefs and streamlined onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Step into the future of AI-powered software engineering – apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

distro-distro:lever:42c1b683-0a26-4479-8.title: Bilingual Senior Tax Accountant
distro-distro:lever:42c1b683-0a26-4479-8.description: We are seeking a skilled, detail-oriented, and **bilingual (English/Spanish) Senior Tax Accountant to join our team in Philadelphia. In this role, you will be a key player in handling complex tax preparation, with a heavy focus on individual income tax returns (Form 1040s) for our diverse clientele. The ideal candidate will be a certified CPA (or actively pursuing licensure) who can confidently consult with clients in both languages, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and an exceptional customer experience. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities ** Prepare and review federal, state, and local individual tax returns (Form 1040s), including schedule C, D, and E filings. Conduct tax consultations and client interviews fluently in both English and Spanish to gather financial data and understand their unique tax situations. Provide proactive tax planning, strategies, and year-round advisory services to individuals and small business owners. Research complex tax issues, interpret tax laws, and ensure strict compliance with IRS regulations. Act as a primary point of contact for Spanish-speaking clients, translating complex financial terms into easily understood advice. Qualifications Education & License: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation is highly preferred; candidate must possess a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance. Language: Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required. Experience: 2+ years of dedicated tax preparation experience, with heavy proficiency in 1040s. Location: Must be local to Philadelphia and able to work daily out of our physical office. Proficiency with standard professional tax software and MS Excel. #VensureEmployerSolutions #LI-Onsite

emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:fde19ec2-f227-46.title: Revenue Operations Lead
emcap-alchemy-2:ashbyhq:fde19ec2-f227-46.description: ABOUT ALCHEMY Alchemy is the Web3 infrastructure and developer platform that powers millions of users and the world’s most innovative blockchain applications. From enabling $1+ trillion in financial transactions worldwide to scaling L2s and enabling DeFi, Alchemy provides the infrastructure and tools developers need to build reliable, scalable, and accessible experiences. Trusted by companies like JPMorgan, Stripe, Visa, Franklin Templeton, Nike, and backed by a16z, Coatue, Silver Lake, Lightspeed, and Stanford University, Alchemy is building the foundational layer for a decentralized and AI-enabled Web3 ecosystem. For more information, visit alchemy.com http://alchemy.com. ABOUT THE ROLE Alchemy’s growth depends on a world-class revenue engine — one that is precise, scalable, and deeply aligned across go-to-market teams. As a Revenue Operations leader, you will be the architect and operator behind that engine. You’ll sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance — designing the systems, processes, and data infrastructure that power every dollar of revenue. This is a high-leverage role: you’ll turn GTM strategy into execution, eliminate friction across the funnel, and build the operating cadence that enables our teams to move faster and win more. You’ll own the full revenue lifecycle — from pipeline generation to forecasting accuracy to expansion — ensuring every motion is measurable, scalable, and continuously improving. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own and evolve Alchemy’s revenue operating system end-to-end: pipeline management, forecasting, territory design, and performance tracking - Build and maintain a best-in-class GTM tech stack (e.g. Salesforce, enrichment tools, analytics layers), ensuring data integrity and usability across teams - Design and optimize core sales processes — from lead routing and qualification to deal progression and close — reducing friction and increasing velocity - Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership to translate strategy into execution plans with clear metrics - Drive forecasting rigor and accuracy: establish frameworks, reporting, and inspection cadences that leadership can trust - Analyze funnel performance across the entire customer journey (lead → opportunity → closed → expansion), identifying bottlenecks and opportunities - Develop dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, and revenue outcomes - Own compensation planning and incentive design in partnership with leadership - Lead territory planning and account segmentation to maximize coverage and efficiency - Ensure alignment across GTM teams through shared definitions, processes, and feedback loops - Introduce automation and scalable best practices across global revenue operations WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations at a high-growth SaaS or infrastructure company - Deep understanding of B2B sales funnels, forecasting methodologies, and pipeline mechanics - Strong systems expertise (Salesforce and adjacent tools) - Analytical mindset with experience building models and translating insights into action - Proven ability to design and implement scalable processes that improve revenue outcomes - Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Product teams - Strong communication skills with the ability to influence across all levels - High ownership and ability to operate in fast-moving, ambiguous environments NICE TO HAVES - Experience in developer tools, infrastructure, or web3 companies - Familiarity with modern GTM tooling (e.g. Pocus, Clay, dbt, Looker) - Experience supporting global sales teams - Background in compensation design and territory modeling BENEFITS AND PERKS 🏥 Medical, Dental, & Vision 💪 Gym Reimbursement 🖥️ Home Office Build-out Budget 🚅 Commuter Benefits 🌴 Flexible Time Off 🥙 In-Office Group Meals 🧘‍♂️ Wellbeing & Mental H

Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. Finance is responsible for managing capital, ensuring financial integrity, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering accurate reporting to drive sustainable growth and profitability. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE As a Finance Business Partner, you will be a key contributor to financial transformation and support the company's growth and profitability objectives. jobgether-jobgether:lever:51d93d59-913e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a QA / Test Automation Engineer based in the United States. As a Mid-Level QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will help ensure the reliability and release readiness of modern Java-based applications hosted in AWS. You will combine manual and automated testing across web applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and end-to-end business processes. The role offers the opportunity to contribute to a large-scale software modernization program within an agile, cloud-focused environment. You will translate requirements and acceptance criteria into thorough test strategies, identify quality risks, and validate fixes throughout the development lifecycle. Working alongside developers, product, DevSecOps, security, data, and business teams, you will help build dependable and secure software. Your work will also support reusable automation, CI/CD quality gates, test coverage, and continuous improvements to testing practices. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced QA professional who enjoys solving complex technical problems and improving software quality. Review user stories, acceptance criteria, application designs, API specifications, data mappings, and AWS documentation to identify test conditions, expected results, and potential quality risks. Create, execute, and maintain manual testing across functional, system, regression, smoke, integration, API, database, data validation, and user acceptance scenarios. Develop and maintain reusable automated test scripts, components, test data, locators, validations, and regression suites using appropriate automation tools and frameworks. Test web interfaces, REST and SOAP APIs, databases, integrations, authentication services, data exchanges, legacy interfaces, workflows, reports, and downstream systems. Execute automated tests across AWS-hosted environments, analyze logs and execution evidence, troubleshoot failures, and maintain test suites as applications evolve. Prepare test data, capture supporting evidence, maintain requirements traceability, and document testing results and release outcomes. Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, expected versus actual results, environment details, and supporting evidence; participate in defect triage and verify fixes. Use application, cloud, and pipeline logs to support defect isolation and root-cause analysis. Collaborate with Java developers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, AWS and DevSecOps engineers, integration and data teams, security specialists, vendors, and business stakeholders throughout sprint and release cycles. Support automated test execution within CI/CD pipelines, scheduled regression testing, and release validation, improving test reliability in partnership with senior QA and DevSecOps team members. Contribute to test estimates, sprint planning, coverage assessments, release-readiness reviews, quality metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives. Help strengthen testing practices related to cloud reliability, security, accessibility, data consistency, and operational readiness. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree and at least four years of experience in software quality assurance, application testing, system testing, or a related technical field. Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust, with approved adjudication required before onboarding; candidates with an existing Public Trust or suitability determination are preferred. Hands-on experience testing Java-based web applications, services, APIs, integrations, databases, and data flows. Practical experience developing, maintaining, executing, and troubleshooting automated tests using one or more automation tools or frameworks. jobgether-jobgether:lever:b28910a1-3ae4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Bulgaria. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation.
